claim: The calendar Q3 2024 filing says NVIDIA's revenue was less than $30.9B.
summary: The claim is contradicted. Calendar Q3 2024 corresponds to NVIDIA fiscal Q3 FY2025 ended Oct 27, 2024, which reported revenue of ~$35.1B ($35,082M), which is not less than $30.9B.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's revenue for calendar Q3 2024 as reported in its filing was less than $30.9B
sub_claims.note: Calendar Q3 2024 maps to NVIDIA fiscal Q3 FY2025 ended Oct 27, 2024 (10-Q filed Nov 2024). That filing reports revenue $35.082B (~$35.1B), which exceeds $30.9B. Fiscal Q2 FY2025 ended July 28, 2024 reported $30.04B but does not cover calendar Q3.
